text:
marta: quick sync on the console footer density and action chips — noticed a few small UX edge cases on narrow screens.

evan: what problems are you seeing?

marta: when the footer has 3 action chips + a primary CTA, chips compress and the focus ring overlaps the CTA on mobile. also toasts show up anchored top-right and visually collide with persistent footers on some dashboards.

chee: seen this on the billing page. chips are using --spacing-1 gap which is too tight in compact contexts. Suggest creating a semantic token --chip-gap-sm with a slightly larger fallback so components can opt in.

ryan: agree on token. For the focus overlap, we can increase chip hit area to 44px but keep visual size small. same pattern as other components.

marta: would rather avoid increasing overall footer height. Could we make chips collapse into a single "more actions" overflow at <= 460px? that preserves the CTA prominence.

evan: collapse makes sense. Keyboard users still need access — the overflow menu must be tabbable and expose aria-controls for each action.

chee: regarding toasts: instead of moving global anchor, add a page-level CSS variable --page-footer-safe that toasts read to offset themselves when present. default 0, pages with sticky footers set it to footer height. keeps global pattern same but allows exceptions.

ryan: implementation idea:
```css
.footer .chip { width:44px; height:44px; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; padding:0; }
.footer .chip .visual { width:20px; height:20px; }
.footer { gap: var(--chip-gap-sm, 10px); }
.toast-stack { top: calc(var(--toast-base-offset, 16px) + var(--page-footer-safe, 0px)); }
```

marta: accessibility notes: chips must have aria-labels (e.g., "Open filters"), and the overflow menu should announce "More actions". Also ensure focus-visible uses the global --focus-ring token for consistent contrast in dark mode.

evan: copy nit: one of the chips says "Save" but it's ambiguous whether that saves dashboard layout or filters. Suggest "Save layout" for clarity.

chee: PR plan: 1) add --chip-gap-sm token, 2) collapse chips into overflow at <=460px, 3) increase interactive hit area but keep visual, 4) add --page-footer-safe hook for toasts, 5) update copy to "Save layout". I'll prototype the collapse behavior and attach screenshots.

ryan: I'll handle CSS + unit tests for focus-visible and toast offset.

marta: perfect. design-bot, can you create a task so we track this across components?

design-bot: Created TASKS-1102 "footer: chip gap token, chip collapse overflow, chip hit area, toast page-safe offset, copy clarity" Milestone: 2.23.0

marta: thanks all — resolving unless someone sees a blocker.
